title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #10

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does the word Guru mean? (1 mark)
   A. A teacher who leads from darkness to light
   B. A river
   C. A festival
   D. A soldier

2. What does Ik Onkar stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Many rivers
   B. There is one God
   C. Two gods
   D. Six directions

3. What is the Indian name for Sunday? (1 mark)
   A. Shanivaar
   B. Mangalvaar
   C. Ravivaar
   D. Somvaar

4. What does it mean to pay your fare honestly? (1 mark)
   A. Pay the right amount and take your change
   B. Hide from the conductor
   C. Pay less
   D. Avoid paying

5. What is a common mistake about lies? (1 mark)
   A. Owning up
   B. Thinking honesty is important
   C. Returning items
   D. Thinking small lies do not matter

6. Who gave the Sigalovada Sutta talk? (1 mark)
   A. Guru Arjan Dev
   B. Valmiki
   C. Mahavir
   D. The Buddha

7. Who brought Siddhartha up after his mother died? (1 mark)
   A. A teacher
   B. A king
   C. His aunt Mahaprajapati Gotami
   D. His cousin Devadatta

8. Which two elements are needed for a crop to grow well? (1 mark)
   A. Water and earth
   B. Fire and metal
   C. Space and salt
   D. Metal and stone

9. Which city did Guru Ram Das Ji start? (1 mark)
   A. Varanasi
   B. Nairobi
   C. Amritsar
   D. Mombasa

10. Which element is called Prithvi? (1 mark)
   A. Air
   B. Earth
   C. Fire
   D. Water

11. Which day is linked with Mars? (1 mark)
   A. Tuesday
   B. Friday
   C. Saturday
   D. Thursday

12. What was Guru Ram Das Ji's childhood name? (1 mark)
   A. Prahlad
   B. Ravi
   C. Siddhartha
   D. Jetha

13. How can children with speech difficulties join prayers at assembly? (1 mark)
   A. They must not attend
   B. By humming or listening
   C. By leaving
   D. By shouting

14. You are sent to buy bread. What is honest behaviour? (1 mark)
   A. Keep some change
   B. Bring back the correct change
   C. Say the bread was more expensive
   D. Buy sweets with the change

15. Which national symbol is raised at Madaraka Day ceremonies? (1 mark)
   A. The school flag
   B. A flag of a sports team
   C. A sail
   D. The national flag

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. What is Dharma? (2 marks)

17. Compare the teachings of Parshvanath and Guru Ram Das Ji. (5 marks)

18. Explain why water is important in our daily lives. (3 marks)

19. Write a short composition on a festival of your choice. (5 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — A teacher who leads from darkness to light
   A guru is a teacher and guide.

2. B — There is one God
   Ik Onkar means One God.

3. C — Ravivaar
   Ravi is the Sun.

4. A — Pay the right amount and take your change
   Honesty includes paying fares.

5. D — Thinking small lies do not matter
   Small lies grow.

6. D — The Buddha
   The Buddha spoke to a young man named Sigala.

7. C — His aunt Mahaprajapati Gotami
   His mother's sister looked after him.

8. A — Water and earth
   Soil and water help a crop to grow.

9. C — Amritsar
   The city that grew into Amritsar.

10. B — Earth
   Prithvi is the Sanskrit word for earth, the soil and rocks.

11. A — Tuesday
   Mangalvaar.

12. D — Jetha
   His childhood name was Jetha.

13. B — By humming or listening
   Everyone can take part in their own way.

14. B — Bring back the correct change
   Bring back all correct change.

15. D — The national flag
   The flag is raised and the anthem sung.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: The right way of living, including duty, honesty and kindness.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for two ideas.

17. (5 marks)
   Answer: Parshvanath taught Ahimsa, truth, not taking what is not given and not being greedy. Guru Ram Das Ji taught equality, honest work, humility and service. Both teach kindness and care for others.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each teaching set and 1 mark for a comparison.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Water is needed for drinking and cooking, for washing and cleaning, and for growing crops and giving drinks to animals. Without it people, animals and plants cannot live.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of three correct points.

19. (5 marks)
   Answer: Any well-organised composition naming the festival, when it is held, what people do, what it teaches and how you feel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for name, timing, activities, meaning, and feeling.
